statistical_scope: Existing scalar means and four-repeat ranges; no node aggregation, scoring, CI or inferential fit.
limits: Whole-graph diagnostic prefixes differ from dependency-cone deployment.
Native local-error and margin scales compare only within model/dataset.
L-M-H line segments are navigation, not interpolation or a feasible frontier.
Fast exact time does not imply three-dimensional dominance or highest accuracy.
Analytic a+bq curves and intersections use existing coefficients, not new executions.
Sampled curves use accepted mean workload times; exact/RAM use registered median coefficients.
Common graph/CP setup is separate; route-specific exact setup/build are paid.
Peaks are observed allocator high-water marks, not isolated minimum capacities.
The guide includes explicitly unmeasured systems alternatives and conditional historical controls.
Missing or partial values are refused; there is no silent range fallback.
